metadata.baseline_source: Unmodified baseline commit src/ with identical bench/main.zig and build.zig added
metadata.method: Serial execution, one full-process warmup per binary, alternating AB/BA pairs, one per-case warmup, 1080p fixtures, full warmup output hashes and per-iteration sampled checksums; setup and fixture encoding excluded; warm file cache
metadata.limitations: One host/architecture and the included synthetic inputs; not a guarantee for every input, allocator, optimization mode, or platform
